description: The donut chart illustrates the win rate percentages of three large language models—GPT-4o, LLaMA, and Mistral—based on comparative evaluations, likely from human or automated preference judgments as described in the paper “Distilling Empathy from Large Language Models.” The chart is divided into three segments: GPT-4o dominates with a 98.4% win rate, represented by a large dark blue outer ring; LLaMA follows with 3.2%, shown as a small light blue segment; and Mistral accounts for 1.2%, depicted as a narrow red segment. The central white circle contains the label “Win rate (%)”, indicating the chart’s focus on relative performance. The segments are visually ordered by size, with GPT-4o’s slice being the most prominent, and the percentages are explicitly labeled with leader lines pointing to each segment. A gray rectangular legend placeholder appears at the bottom right, though it is unlabeled in this version of the chart. The visual design emphasizes the overwhelming performance advantage of GPT-4o over the other two models in the evaluated context.
